# Welcome to Fakt Discussions 👋

Fakt is a Kotlin compiler plugin that generates type-safe test fakes from `@Fake` interfaces, FIR → IR, KMP-first.

This is the place for **questions, design conversations, and showing off**. Reproducible bugs and regressions still go to [Issues](../../issues).

## 🧭 Where to post what

- **Reproducible bug or regression:** [Issues → Bug Report](../../issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
- **"How do I…" or "why does my build fail":** [🙏 Q&A](../../discussions/categories/q-a)
- **API change, new annotation, or pipeline idea:** [💡 Ideas](../../discussions/categories/ideas)
- **Project, blog post, or talk that uses Fakt:** [🙌 Show & tell](../../discussions/categories/show-and-tell)
- **Security vulnerability:** [Report privately via Security Advisories](../../security/advisories/new) — do **not** post here

## ✅ Before posting in Q&A

- Read the [docs](https://rsicarelli.github.io/fakt/) and the [Contributing guide](../../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- The Q&A form asks for Kotlin version, KMP targets, Fakt version, and a question — compiler plugin questions without those are usually unanswerable.

## ⏱ Expectations

Fakt is pre-1.0 with a **single maintainer**. Q&A is best-effort; well-formed posts (with version info + a reproducer) get answered first. Show & tell has no SLA — reactions when seen.

If you open an Issue that's actually a question, expect it to be converted to a Discussion. It's not a rejection — it's filing.
